title: Bao Sums
author: Somo team (XPRIZE Kenya)
description: Sow seeds pit by pit while Somo counts aloud, then do the sum. Level 2: start from the bigger number. Level 3: the missing number (7 + ? = 10).
description_sw: Panda mbegu shimo kwa shimo huku Somo akihesabu kwa sauti, kisha fanya hesabu. Kiwango 2: anza na namba kubwa. Kiwango 3: namba inayokosekana (7 + ? = 10).

lines.en: Tap the green button to start.
Look at the last pit we sowed. Its number is the answer.
lines.sw: Angalia shimo la mwisho tulilopanda. Namba yake ndiyo jibu.

lines.en: Here is our bao board. Some pits are full. Tap Sow to drop one seed in the next pit, and count on with me.
lines.sw: Hii ni bao letu. Mashimo mengine yamejaa. Gusa Panda kudondosha mbegu moja kwenye shimo linalofuata, na tuhesabu pamoja.

lines.en: Now start from the BIGGER number. It is faster to count on from the big one.
lines.sw: Sasa anza na namba KUBWA. Ni rahisi kuendelea kuhesabu kutoka kubwa.

lines.en: Now find the missing number. Sow until you reach the flag.
lines.sw: Sasa tafuta namba inayokosekana. Panda hadi ufike kwenye bendera.

lines.en: {a} plus {b}. Which number do we start from?
We have {a}. How many more to make {t}? Sow to the flag.
lines.sw: Tuna {a}. Ngapi zaidi kufanya {t}? Panda hadi kwenye bendera.

lines.en: How many seeds did we sow? {a} plus how many is {t}?
lines.sw: Tumepanda mbegu ngapi? {a} jumlisha ngapi ni {t}?

lines.en: Yes, the bigger one. We start at {a}.
Which is bigger, {a} or {b}? Start from the bigger one.
lines.sw: Ipi ni kubwa, {a} au {b}? Anza na kubwa.

lines.en: Count only the new seeds, the ones we sowed.
lines.sw: Hesabu mbegu mpya tu, zile tulizopanda.

lines.en: Start at {a}. Count on: {seq}. {a} plus {b} is {c}.
